# legacy-engineering-mcp

> legacy-engineering-mcp — MCP server by MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- calculate_passive_drainage
- get_lime_kiln_parameters
- get_fens_drainage_geometry
- get_lime_mortar_composition
- analyze_thermal_mass

## Install
```
pip install legacy-engineering-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/legacy-engineering-mcp/
